name: Beyond Net
summary: Townsville dialup + web design + hardware retail ISP (by 1998); defunct.

events.details: Earliest email use 24 Feb 1998 (dave-james@beyond.net.au); earliest Wayback capture 12 Dec 1998.
Retail homepage (with news scroller citing upstream provider Comindico) ran through Aug 2005; from ~30 Aug 2005 www.beyond.net.au 301-redirected to yourhub.com.au.
ABN 28 653 682 010 (BEYOND NETWORK SOLUTIONS PTY LTD, NSW, active from 1 Jul 2026) is a later same-name entity, unrelated to this Townsville ISP; not the ISP's operator.
